svg.title: Blank dark blue embroidered flight suit name tag (FDU / CFDU)
svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"nametag-flight-embroidered-blank","name":"Blank dark blue embroidered flight suit name tag (FDU / CFDU)","size_in":{"w":4,"h":2},"units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,400,200],"size_source":"estimated","size_basis":"Same 2 x 4 in footprint as the leather tag (8.2.4.1: a cloth tag is authorized in place of leather on the same loop tape); silver border from Fig A6-3","provenance":"in-house construction from Fig A6-3 (flight suit name tags): shape, border, stitch only, no lettering","colours":{"body":"#1c2742","edge":"#0e1426","stitch":"#9aa6c4"},"anchors":{"top_center":[200,0],"bottom_center":[200,200],"center":[200,100],"left_edge":[0,100],"right_edge":[400,100],"name_center":[200,107],"grade_left":[20,162.5],"cap_right":[380,162.5],"badge_center":[200,46]},"landmarks":{"tag":{"x":0,"y":0,"w":400,"h":200},"name_zone":{"x":45,"y":82,"w":310,"h":50},"grade_zone":{"x":20,"y":145,"w":100,"h":35},"cap_zone":{"x":280,"y":145,"w":100,"h":35},"badge_zone":{"x":45,"y":15,"w":310,"h":62}},"landmarks_note":"rects are {x,y,w,h} in user units (0.01 in): name line (first and last name), grade lower left (\"Cadet\" for all cadets), \"CAP\" lower right, up to two badges (CAP aeronautical rating / occupational / mission qualification) above the name (8.2.4.1)","text":{"lines":[{"zone":"name_zone","content":"first and last name","align":"center"},{"zone":"grade_zone","content":"grade (\"Cadet\" for cadets; NCO grade for NCOs; none printed on the officer cloth tag)","align":"left"},{"zone":"cap_zone","content":"CAP","align":"right"}]},"documented":["blue cloth embroidered nametag with silver border and lettering authorized in place of the leather tag if cloth grade insignia is worn (8.2.4.1)"],"assumed":["stitch line inset","corner radius","zone positions read from Fig A6-3"],"grade":"insignia-plate","fastener":"hook and loop on 2 x 4 in loop tape","fit":{"method":"n/a","score":null}}
